decisions.text: type treemap: 15 parts, more than the 6–7 a pie or stacked bar holds (D-23 (a)), and fractions or subtotals are the message: a treemap (G1.39); or lump the parts unimportant to the message into one All others part in the data (R7-17), and a pie holds
the parts largest first, squarified, the largest at the top left (G7.34); gaps of 1 pt
one colour: the parts are told apart by place and name, not by colour
13 of 15 tiles named inside, at the bottom left; 3 shortened with “…”; 2 too small to name, counted in a note (a static chart has no tooltips) (G7.34)

source.shows: fractions of fifteen parts, more than a pie's 6–7 (D-23 (a)): a treemap (R7-15, G1.39), unless the parts unimportant to the message are lumped into All others first (R7-17, P3-03)
